title: Grateful Dead Live at Monterey Performing Arts Center on 1969-06-14
lineage: Dat > Tascam DA-40 > Tascam DA-3000 > WAV 16/48
taper: Recorded by Bear DAT source from Joel Pollack
source: SBD > Bear’s master cassette (Ampex C90) > Dick’s cassette (TDK-SA-X100) > DAT 16bit/48kHz

ai_review.summary: Recording quality unknown, but the tape delivers an unhinged psychedelic blues set with standout Dark Star and The Eleven.
ai_review.review: The performance bursts with 1969 energy, featuring a spirited Eleven, a dark‑but‑slightly uneven Dark Star, and Pigpen’s humor‑filled second Lovelight. Reviewers are enthusiastic about the music yet give no concrete details on the audio source, leaving the recording quality uncertain.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviewers praise the musical performance despite lacking any recording‑quality comments; with only two reviews confidence is moderate.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No reviewer mentions soundboard, audience bleed, or clarity; therefore recording quality cannot be assessed beyond being adequate for listening.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A short, classic 1969 set that feels exploratory and psychedelic, with high‑energy jams despite a few uneven moments.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Described as playing excitedly and fast during The Eleven; Dark Star noted as slightly below average for ’69.
